name: PM
description: Base module of the Drupal PM suite providing a project-management dashboard and shared entity framework for work-tracking submodules.
project_description:
Drupal PM is a suite of Project Management and Work Tracking tools for Drupal 11. 

 
 Info 
 
Version 4.x is a complete rewrite focused on Drupal 10/11 compatibility. Some features from previous versions may not be available yet. If you have feature requests or find issues, please use the issue queue .

 
 The suite contains several components, structured as separate Drupal modules:

 
 Organizations 
 Projects 
 Epics 
 Features 
 Stories 
 Tasks 
 Sub Tasks 
 Timetracking 
 Notes 
 Expenses 
 Invoices 
 Personas 
 Board (Kanban view) 
 REST API support 
 
 Each component is structured in a manner that allows easy integration with other Drupal modules. Drupal PM uses Field API for storing data and Views for displaying lists of data.

 Demo 
 Try Drupal PM on Simplytest.me 

 Resources 
 
 
 
 Drupal.org 
 
 
 
 
 Issues Queue for discussion of specific changes to this module, including reporting of bugs.
